name: Town South Gate
arrivalText: The wooden southern gate archway stands tall, overlooking the lush river meadows and the winding Silverbrook path.
description: The southern entrance checkpoint of Oakhaven Hamlet. It opens directly to the sunlit meadows and fertile river farmlands.
visualTheme: A wide timber archway gate with stone foundation, overlooking farm paths and fields.

history.createdWhy: Erected to regulate incoming agricultural trade and taxation from southern farming plots.
history.builtWho: Silas Senior and local town builders.
history.majorEvents: A massive flood reached the gate base three summers ago.
history.whyExists: Primary entry point for farmers, shepherds, and fishermen.
history.currentConflicts: Local wolves occasionally raid the nearby pastures, calling for defense.

npcs.name: Guard Cory
dialogue: Beautiful day to fish at the docks, isn't it?
Watch out for slimes in the Meadows. They're sticky and annoying.
The South Gate is always peaceful, just how I like it.
